visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Seven females, including one adult woman and six young girls, are positioned in a classroom setting, all holding silver flutes. They are looking directly at the camera, smiling, and speaking in unison. Each person has a digit overlaid near them from 1 to 7. The classroom background features storage cabinets filled with educational materials, a crescent moon decoration, and windows showing the night sky outside. (2) The group transitions from speaking to a playing posture. Some girls adjust their flutes to their lips, while others remain still. The woman in the center background also holds her flute ready. The environment remains brightly lit with overhead lights reflecting off the metallic surfaces of the flutes. There is a large purple caption box at the center of the frame asking a question in English and Chinese. (3) Several individuals begin moving their fingers over the flute keys and blowing into the mouthpieces, creating a visual sense of performance. Specifically, characters 1, 2, 4, and 7 show visible finger agitation, suggesting they are the ones playing. The other girls, 3, 5, and 6, hold their instruments static without blowing or moving their fingers. The camera stays static throughout this performance segment, focusing on the girls' upper bodies.
